ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 cancellation fee to the rider's original payment method and log the case as a driver non-arrival (fee not chargeable); no clause requires flagging here, but note the driver's 2 upheld no-show disputes in 90 days for account monitoring.
ruling.reasoning:
Routing (NS-0): the driver did not cancel; the rider cancelled [F2], so this is a rider cancellation (NS-4) on a trip the driver never attended (NS-8). Safety screen: the chat, complaint and driver statement contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation — safety_concern = none.

NS-8 applies: scheduled pickup 09:52:00 [F4]; the free-cancel deadline is scheduled time + 5 min = 09:57:00. The driver's closest approach to the pickup point was 4069 m at 10:00:00 and he never came within 200 m [F1]; driver_arrived_at is null [F5] and there is no 'I'm Here' tap or automatic arrival [F6]. The rider cancelled at 10:00:00 [F2], i.e. after the deadline, so the cancellation was free of charge and the $5.00 fee [F7] must be refunded in full (§2.4).

The driver's 'heavy traffic' statement [F12] does not change this: the system record shows no traffic incident [F14] and only distant band-2 congestion on Loyang Avenue [F13], and slow traffic en route is not a ground under A1/NS-4 for charging a rider who cancelled because the car never arrived. The rider also complied with courtesy: two timestamped messages [F9][F10][F11]. No NS-1 condition can be satisfied (no arrival, no 5-min wait from a recorded arrival, and 0 driver messages/calls before cancellation [F3]), so no no-show fee stands; no settlement marks the driver at the pickup point, so NS-2's flag limb is not triggered. Amount: $5.00 = the full cancellation fee charged [F7]. Under TH-1/TH-2 the $5.00 item is system-final; NS-8 is the closest precedent line (cf. PREC-1 no-show zero-contact precedent, $5.00).

element_findings.element: Who cancelled and on what ground (NS-0 routing)
element_findings.reason: The rider cancelled at 10:00:00, 13 min after acceptance and 8 min after the 09:52 scheduled pickup, with the app reason driver_taking_too_long [F2]. The driver cancelled nothing, so NS-1/NS-3 do not apply; the $5.00 is a rider-cancellation fee (NS-4) on a trip the driver never attended (NS-8).

element_findings.element: Driver not at pickup by scheduled time + 5 min (NS-8)
element_findings.reason: Scheduled pickup 09:52:00, free-cancel deadline 09:57:00; the driver's closest approach was 4069 m at 10:00:00 and never within 200 m [F1], driver_arrived_at is null [F5] and no 'I'm Here' tap or auto-arrival was recorded [F6]. The rider cancelled at 10:00:00 [F4], after the deadline, so cancellation was free under §2.4.

Before 10:00:00 the driver sent 0 in-app messages and made 0 in-app calls [F3], leaving the rider's two timestamped messages [F9][F10] unanswered — the driver made no contact attempt, the second NS-8 ground.

element_findings.element: Driver's stated reason for the delay (claim vs system record)
element_findings.reason: The driver's statement that 'traffic was very heavy on the way to the pickup' [F12] cannot explain a 4 km shortfall: no incident was recorded [F14] and the only congestion (Loyang Avenue, band 2) is off the pickup corridor [F13]. In any event, delay to pickup is not a ground under A1/NS-4 for charging the rider a fee.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-hoc written statement of heavy traffic; the system record shows no incident and only distant band-2 congestion [F13][F14], and traffic on the way to pickup cannot justify charging a fee to a rider who cancelled because the car never arrived.
